interpretation: The 24MP wall time is distributed across repeated float64/float32 colour transforms, two fixed-iteration gamut searches, safe-Lab execution, and PNG compression. No single Python parameter or I/O-only change can plausibly satisfy the unchanged 15 second product gate. Further work on this product path requires a fused parallel native arithmetic and streaming publication mechanism rather than another Python staging rescue.
limitations: This is post-result diagnostic attribution, not a preregistered performance gate.
The absolute wall time may include ordinary host contention; the profile is used to localize work, not to claim cross-machine performance.
No native implementation or product capability is claimed.
